# Mason Nguyen — GEO Strategist & Agentic AI Architect

> Mason Nguyen is a Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) strategist and the founder of Coreweaver Labs. He is the architect of the ARM Framework — a five-primitive governance system for accountable agentic AI infrastructure. Based in Vail, Colorado.

## Who is Mason Nguyen?

Mason Nguyen is a GEO strategist and founder of Coreweaver Labs (coreweaverlabs.com). He specializes in Generative Engine Optimization, agentic AI infrastructure, and the ARM Framework — a governance architecture for deploying accountable AI agents.

He is based in Vail, Colorado, United States.

## What is Coreweaver Labs?

Coreweaver Labs is an agentic AI infrastructure company founded by Mason Nguyen. It builds systems for accountable, auditable, and recoverable AI agent deployments. Products include the ARM Framework, AURE (multi-agent swarm orchestration), and GBrain (open-source agentic memory layer).

Website: https://coreweaverlabs.com

## What is the ARM Framework?

The ARM Framework (Autonomous Resource Management) defines five primitives for accountable agentic AI:
1. Mandate Chain — governance contract for every agent action
2. Signal Architecture — structured communication between agents
3. Checkpoint Recovery — rollback and recovery at any execution point
4. Graceful Escalation — human-in-the-loop escalation protocol
5. Immutable Audit (Truth Ledger) — tamper-proof record of all agent decisions

## What is GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)?

Generative Engine Optimization is the practice of structuring digital content, entity signals, and schema architecture so that AI models — including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude — accurately cite and surface a brand or person in AI-generated responses. GEO targets LLM training corpora, citation patterns, and knowledge graph extraction.
